services.name: Venue Rentals
services.desc: As a venue, the National Tennis Center has a diverse selection of event locations, from fan villages to covered stadiums. Each location is available to rent individually or we can combine locations to fit your needs. Arthur Ashe Stadium has the distinction of being the largest tennis stadium in the world, with a seating capacity of over 23,000, inclusive of our luxury suites. As of 2016, it boasts a new retractable roof that closes to protect from the elements. The arena is available for concerts, sporting events, conventions, or stage an intimate event right on center court.
